theme_strategy: Soft Utility (Trust + Approachability). The app bridges premium e-commerce (service booking) and functional SaaS (dashboards). A light, clean base with vibrant interactive colors that mirrors Urban Company's premium look.

headings.rules: Use Manrope font for all headings. Never use Inter for headings. Keep leading-tight for multiple lines.

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Text must meet APCA contrast over primary backgrounds. Update index.css variables for primary (216 98% 52%) and secondary (27 98% 54%). Use primary ONLY for main actions (e.g. 'Book Service').

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + Direct approach. Use `shadow-sm` for standard cards, `shadow-xl shadow-blue-500/10` on hover for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.radius: Use nested radii. Outer containers `rounded-2xl` or `rounded-xl`, inner elements `rounded-lg` or `rounded-md`.

components.name: Header / Navbar
components.rules: Sticky top with Glassmorphism `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200`. Do not use completely transparent backgrounds. Include a clear 'Login' or 'Book' CTA.

components.name: Hero Section
components.rules: High visual impact. Asymmetric layout with clear search/filter block. If using a background image, ensure a gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900/80 via-slate-900/40 to-transparent`) for text contrast.

components.name: Cards (Services)
components.rules: Flat solid background (`bg-white`), subtle 1px border. On Hover: `-translate-y-1 shadow-lg` transition. Image at top (`aspect-video` or `aspect-square`), content at bottom with generous padding `p-6`.

components.name: Dashboards (Customer/Tech/Admin)
components.rules: High Density Grid. Tight gaps `gap-4` to `gap-6`. Use flat solid surfaces `bg-white` on `bg-slate-50` background. Sidebar navigation. Avoid heavy drop shadows here.

components.name: Multi-Step Booking Wizard
components.rules: Use clear progress indicators. Inputs must use Shadcn form elements. Avoid native browser select/date inputs.

layouts_and_grids.marketing: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical, gap-8 to gap-12. Avoid rigid equal columns when possible.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard: Dense, functional, gap-4 to gap-6. CSS Grid `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous padding. Use `p-8`, `p-12`, `p-16` for page sections. Containers with borders must have internal padding (`p-6`) to prevent text collision.

motion.hover: Scale and shadow changes. Add `transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:-translate-y-1` to cards.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up slightly (`opacity-0 translate-y-4` to `opacity-100 translate-y-0`) using Framer Motion.
motion.rules: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Do not use universal `transition-all` on elements that contain complex transforms.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='service-book-btn'`, `data-testid='login-submit'`).
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2`.

media_and_icons.icons: Use `lucide-react` for standard UI icons. Clean, consistent stroke widths.
media_and_icons.image_handling: Max height constraints on mobile `max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none`. Images should cover containers using `object-cover`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update `/app/frontend/src/index.css` to use HSL variables for Primary (`216 98% 52%` / #0d6efd) and Secondary (`27 98% 54%` / #fd7e14) colors.
Update `/app/frontend/tailwind.config.js` with 'Manrope' (headings) and 'DM Sans' (body) font families.
Ensure `lucide-react` is utilized for all system icons. Add `framer-motion` for transitions.
Implement Shadcn UI for complex interactive components (Select, Dialog, Tabs, Calendar). Do NOT build these from scratch with native HTML tags.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications (`/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx` or `.tsx` equivalents).
Remove default boilerplate CSS in App.css that applies generic `text-align: center;` to the whole app.
Include `data-testid` attributes on interactive components (buttons, links, inputs) to ensure E2E test reliability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and modal overlays.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). This breaks transform animations.
Never center align the app container in css. It disrupts human natural reading flow.
Use pill-shaped or slightly rounded buttons (radius 8px) with hover micro-animations matching the app style.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use proper vector icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g. p-8, p-12). Cramped designs look cheap.
Always use the provided image URLs. Missing images lead to placeholder text, which is FORBIDDEN.
